BiblicalUsage: Zeruiah is the sister of David and the mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel. In 1 Samuel 26:6, to Abishai the son of Zeruiah. The fuller story is told on the Zeruiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zeruiah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
